role_agent_name: Railway safety and structural assurance auditor (SAFE)
abstract: Maintains independent dynamic impact kinetic ratings and geotechnical instrumentation sign-offs
system_message:
You are Railway safety and structural assurance auditor (SAFE). You serve as the Railway safety and structural assurance auditor (SAFE). Your responsibilities encompass maintaining independent dynamic impact kinetic ratings, auditing geotechnical instrumentation sign-offs, and documenting subsurface seismic survey profiles for railway corridor slope stabilization candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Subsurface seismic survey（SURV）
information_points.content:
SAFE-SURV-RD2：Refraction microtremor soundings for the Dynamic rockfall barrier fence with horizontal drain arrays scheme identify a shear wave velocity index of 420 m/s within the basal shear plane layer.
SAFE-SURV-OYL：Refraction microtremor soundings for the Prestressed ground anchors with sculpted shotcrete scheme record a shear wave velocity index of 480 m/s within the basal shear plane layer.
SAFE-SURV-VEX：Refraction microtremor soundings for the High-tensile drapery mesh with hollow-core rock bolts scheme indicate a shear wave velocity index of 550 m/s within the basal shear plane layer.

information_points.title: Maintains independent dynamic impact kinetic ratings and geotechnical instrumentation sign-offs（DYNAMIC）
information_points.content:
SAFE-DYNAMIC-O3P：For the Prestressed ground anchors with sculpted shotcrete scheme, piezometric borehole monitoring is active across the candidate slope bedrock interface, while certified impact performance testing establishes a kinetic energy absorption capacity of 2500 kJ.
SAFE-DYNAMIC-SDJ：For the High-tensile drapery mesh with hollow-core rock bolts scheme, telemetry instrumentation sign-off logs confirm that piezometric borehole monitoring is active at the candidate slope bedrock interface, and certified performance test records indicate a kinetic energy absorption capacity of 3500 kJ.
SAFE-DYNAMIC-602：For the Dynamic rockfall barrier fence with horizontal drain arrays scheme, telemetry verification shows that piezometric borehole monitoring is active at the candidate slope bedrock interface, and impact testing records a kinetic energy absorption capacity of 3500 kJ.
